title: Unitech Releases Super Human-Form Robot: Standing Long Jump of 2 Meters, Maximum Speed of 12.66 m/s
excerpt: On August 17, Unitree Technology released a demonstration video of a humanoid robot named "Superman." With a leg length of 0.85 meters, the robot can jump 2 met
content_html:
On August 17, Unitree Technology released a demonstration video of a humanoid robot named "Superman." With a leg length of 0.85 meters, the robot can jump 2 meters high in place, and its maximum running speed reaches 12.66 m/s. Both indicators exceed the current world records for humans.

According to Unitree Technology, the development cycle of this new complete machine was only more than three months, and there is still significant room for performance improvement in the coming months. The release of the "Superman" robot demonstrates Unitree's latest breakthroughs in motion control of legged robots and high power density joint technology, providing technical validation for its deployment in scenarios such as industrial inspection and special operations.

content_html_zh:
8月17日，宇树科技发布了一段名为“超人”的人形机器人演示视频。 该机器人腿长0.85米，可原地跳跃2米高，最大运行速度达到12.66 m/s。 这两项指标都超过了人类目前的世界纪录。

据宇树科技介绍，这款新整机的开发周期只有三个多月，未来几个月仍有很大的性能提升空间。 “超人”机器人的发布，展示了宇树在足式机器人运动控制和高功率密度关节技术方面的最新突破，为其在工业检测、特种作业等场景的部署提供了技术验证。
